generation.prompt_exact: EDIT the supplied project-generated California sycamore (Platanus racemosa) sprite into a SEPARATE BARE WOOD AND ROOT production layer. Preserve the specific recognizable trunk shape, fork junctions, roots, mottled cream/gray/tan bark, side view and warm upper-left lighting of this exact reference tree. Remove ALL foliage and leaves. Invent plausible bare twig continuations where foliage previously concealed wood; this is a newly authored candidate, not recovery of original hidden geometry. Natural irregular sycamore branch architecture, fine tapered twigs. Detailed naturalistic PIXEL ART with deliberate crisp square pixel clusters and stepped outlines; do not turn into smooth painting. No snow, no ground rectangle, no decorative framing, no birds, no text. Root collar and a few original contact stones only. Transparent background with real alpha, including all gaps between twigs. Full tree entirely inside image. Use a square production canvas, centered trunk base at normalized x=0.53 y=0.93, tallest twig at y about 0.08, branches occupying x from about 0.08 to 0.92. Maintain substantial transparent margin. This will become the reference for separately generated canopy layers. Bare trunk must remain low-key and suitable behind detailed birds.

Do NOT introduce any wood, branches, trunk, roots, rocks, shadow, ground, outline box or scene. Keep fully empty alpha where the supplied foliage is absent, and expand the transparent holes within existing crown without changing coordinate system. Every visible leaf must be fully contained within transparent border, no cut edges. Real alpha outside leaves and inside foliage gaps. Same warm upper-left lighting and species morphology: Platanus racemosa broad palmately lobed leaves. No text or checkerboard. This is one separate static foliage-state overlay; it will be aligned over the same bare wood as the healthy canopy.

generation.prompt_exact: Create a transparent PNG sprite sheet of FOUR separated California sycamore leaf assets (Platanus racemosa), naturalistic detailed PIXEL ART matching the supplied project tree's olive green/cream/tan palette and crisp square pixel clusters. This is original project art. Layout is a precise 2 by 2 grid with very broad empty transparent gutters, each asset fully inside its own quadrant, no labels, no lines, no background, no checkerboard and no UI. Top left: ONE healthy medium green sycamore leaf, flat three-quarter orientation, five broad pointed lobes and long petiole, visible pale veins. Top right: ONE dry tan/brown sycamore leaf, same species shape, slightly curled and papery with long petiole, not red maple or oak. Bottom left: one low loose ground-contact cluster of 7 to 10 dry tan sycamore leaves, some curled, natural flat overlap, no soil tile. Bottom right: one smaller ground-contact cluster of 3 to 5 mixed dull olive and dry ochre sycamore leaves, slightly different footprint. Preserve botanical species identity: broad palmately lobed sycamore leaves with strong veins and long petioles, avoid generic seven-to-nine-point maple silhouette. Upper-left warm light, restrained contrast, subtle minimal local contact shading only. Real alpha outside each leaf and inside all open gaps. Each quadrant must have 15 percent clear margin on all four sides; no asset touches gutter or image edges. Large detailed resolution for extraction, but readable stepped pixel contours and coherent game sprite perspective. No birds, pots, branches, lettering or icons.
